namespace Shop.Api
{
    using System;

    // public class Commented { }
    public interface IOrders<in T> where T : notnull
    {
        Task<Order?> FindAsync(Guid id, CancellationToken ct = default);
        event EventHandler Created;
    }

    internal static class Extensions
    {
        public static readonly Func<int, int> Twice = x => x * 2;
        public static string Describe(this Order o) =>
            $"{o.Id}: {o.Lines.Count switch { 0 => "empty", _ => "full" }}";
        private const string Template = @"{ ""a"": 1 }";

        public static T Pick<T>(IEnumerable<T> xs) where T : class
        {
            var list = new List<T>();
            if (list.Count == 0) throw new InvalidOperationException("x {");
            return list[0];
        }
    }

    namespace Models
    {
        public class Order
        {
            public Guid Id { get; set; }
            public List<string> Lines { get; } = new();
            public decimal Total
            {
                get { return 0; }
            }
            public static bool operator ==(Order a, Order b) => true;
            public static bool operator !=(Order a, Order b) => false;
        }
    }
}
